caption: Pull-based GitOps: CI only builds images and commits a new tag to the deploy repository. Argo CD, running inside the cluster, pulls that desired state and reconciles the cluster to it, so no credentials for the cluster ever leave it.
alt: A developer merges to the application repository. CI tests and builds an image, pushes it to the registry, and commits the new image tag to a separate deploy repository. Inside the cluster, Argo CD watches the deploy repository, pulls the manifests, pulls the image from the registry, and applies the result. A pull request that changes the production overlay promotes the same tag to production.

groups.label: Outside: CI writes only to Git and the registry
